timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Mr Peter Foss, thank you for talking to us.
First of all, there are various reforms being undertaken as far as food processing is concerned in India.
How do you look at all these reforms being undertaken in India?
I think it is very positive what's happening in India in this area.
My company is called Foss and we make food quality analysis.
So our small role is to assist in making sure farmers get a transparent and fair payment
and that we can assist in making sustainable food production in India for 1.4 billion people.
And the reforms that are taking place is certainly supporting and making it likely that you will succeed in this transition.
And we are happy in Denmark.
We are fortunate enough to have some technology companies that can insist you in this process.
We had a very positive conference here and I think one of the things that all Danes took away from
this session was his expression about fear of missing out.
His advice to the Danish technology companies don't miss out on investing in India
which has a great future for us.
And I think that was amongst all the participants a sense that this was the way to go forward.
And we look forward to doing more business in India.
